name: Daryl the Youngling
summary: At Farstrider Lodge, Daryl the Youngling tests his hunting skill among veteran dwarven trackers. He challenges travelers to prove their marksmanship against Loch Modan's beasts.

sections.title: A Human Among Mountaineers
sections.body: Farstrider Lodge shelters dwarven mountaineers, trackers, and seasoned outdoorsmen who watch over Loch Modan's wilderness. Daryl is a young human trying to earn a place among them. He measures his hunting instincts against other travelers, challenging them to hunt the tough wild boars and beasts that roam the crags and lakeshore.

faq.answer: Daryl is a young human hunter at Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan. Among the lodge's seasoned dwarven marksmen, he challenges newcomers to test their skill at hunting beasts and tracking.
Daryl stays at Farstrider Lodge, on forested cliffs above Loch Modan's southeastern shores.

The lodge's dwarven marksmen and regulars have spent decades patrolling Khaz Modan's rugged backcountry. Daryl is young and untested by comparison, still working to earn a lasting reputation as a hunter.

angles.text: Daryl's contests test the tracking, knowledge of beast behaviour, and hunting skill that wandering hunters bring to Farstrider Lodge.
As a human, you can find a young person learning wilderness craft deep in dwarven territory, where practical camaraderie joins Ironforge and the human kingdoms.
